footnote_text: The reporting person effected multiple same-way open market sale transactions on the same day at different prices through a sale order executed by a broker-dealer. The reporting person reported on a single line all such transactions that occurred within a one dollar price range. The reporting person hereby undertakes to provide upon request by the SEC staff, the issuer, or a shareholder of the issuer, full information regarding the number of shares sold at each separate price. || Reflects the weighted average sale price.
